legacy_snapshot.note: The original Hype map from Signals: net managers in the latest well-covered report quarter (every change on file) against each stock's trailing three months to its latest close. Mixed clocks — the 13F quarter ended months before the price window does — so it is a snapshot of what is known now, not a transition series.

quarter_aligned.note: Report quarter q: comparable managers (complete 13Fs for q and the quarter before) — added minus cut — against the price from the end of the quarter before to the end of q. Retrospective: these 13Fs were public only weeks after the quarter end. Officials: transactions dated in the quarter (reported later).

public_knowledge_asof.note: Decision day: the first trading day after the 13F deadline (quarter end + 45 days, moved to a trading day). Only comparable 13F pairs whose filings were all filed before that day; price: trailing 63 trading days to it; forward: from its close over the next 4 and 12 weeks, minus SPY over the same days (blank until those weeks have passed). Officials: reports filed in the 91 days before the decision day. "live" = the quarter being filed, as of the latest close, partial.
